transcript.text: Thanks for making time, Dana. I wanted to use today's one-on-one to go through the feedback from the quarterly review. Overall it is very positive: the migration of the billing service landed two weeks early and support tickets for billing dropped by a third.

transcript.speaker: SPEAKER_2
transcript.text: That's good to hear. I was worried the rollout weekend would come up as a problem.

transcript.speaker: SPEAKER_1
transcript.text: It came up, but as a lesson rather than a problem. The one thing reviewers asked for is more written design notes before a big change, so other teams can follow what is coming. They also said you could delegate more of the on-call work to Omar now that he has ramped up.

transcript.speaker: SPEAKER_2
transcript.text: Fair. I have been holding on to on-call because the handover document is not finished. I can finish it this month.

transcript.speaker: SPEAKER_1
transcript.text: Good. On the promotion question: I think you are ready for senior, and I will put you forward in the next cycle. I'll send you the draft of the promotion packet by Friday so you can add your own examples.

transcript.speaker: SPEAKER_2
transcript.text: Great, thank you. I'll read it over the weekend.
